_howto: Add one object per project. Required: tag (industry, geography), title, summary, metric, metricLabel. Optional: href (+ hrefLabel) renders the card as a link and puts it in the page's JSON-LD; anonymous:true renders without the client name pressure; status:'placeholder' renders as a dashed coming-soon card. Vocabulary: the Brain (never agents / agentic / autonomous); RockProsUSA numbers are always 'over the first twelve months'; no numbers for any other client (data/brain-narrative.md §5). Run `node scripts/gencases.mjs` after editing.

cases.title: RockProsUSA: 13 quarries on one dispatch system
cases.summary: Dispatch, invoicing and reporting moved onto one system across 13 quarry sites, with three native iPhone apps for customers, drivers and haulers. The Brain proposes each truck assignment with its reasoning and a dispatcher approves it; invoices are matched against the delivery and the order without a manual pass; the daily report is written by 6 AM. Over the first twelve months: 2,140 invoices with zero manual touches, 11,200 operations hours returned.
cases.metricLabel: quarry sites on one system · 2,140 invoices, zero touches

story.title: RockProsUSA: 13 quarries on one dispatch system
story.description: RockProsUSA mines decorative rock at 13 quarries in the American Southwest. We built the system that moves it: dispatch, invoicing, reporting and three iPhone apps.

hero.sub: RockProsUSA mines decorative rock across the American Southwest. We built what moves it, from the order to the truck to the invoice.
hero.alt: Aerial view of a red-rock RockProsUSA quarry below a desert mountain, with crushing plant and stockpiles

lines: RockProsUSA quarries landscape, architectural and boulder rock in 22 colours, and ships it by truck to contractors, landscapers and distributors across the western United States.

before.h2: Thirteen quarries ran on phone calls.
lines: Orders came in by phone and text. Trucks went to whoever called first.
Weighbridge tickets, delivery notes and purchase orders met for the first time at month end.

built.sub: A load, an invoice and a production number describe the same event, so nobody reconciles them later.

cases.title: CitiSense: AI marketing & sales platform for agencies
cases.summary: An AI-enabled marketing and sales platform for advertising and creative agencies and display teams: campaign operations, sales workflows and reporting carried by the Brain, so the creative teams do creative work.

cases.title: Freight reconciliation without the reconciliation week
cases.summary: Every carrier bill line matched against the weighbridge ticket (the weight recorded at the gate), gate and delivery data. Clean lines clear automatically; disputed lines queue for a person with the evidence attached.
cases.metricLabel: clear automatically; disputes carry their evidence

cases.title: AR follow-up: no account goes quiet
cases.summary: Receivables chased on a cadence you set and escalated on rules. Promises to pay are tracked to their date and re-chased the morning after they break, with every escalation handed to a person.
cases.metricLabel: DSO (days to get paid) measured against the prior baseline

cases.title: AI-assisted image annotation platform
cases.summary: A labelling platform for machine-learning datasets: polygon and bounding-box tooling on canvas, with a detection model running in the browser to pre-annotate every image before a human touched it. Projects, datasets and team notifications built in; exports to Pascal-VOC XML and JSON. Four engineers, 117 commits, shipped in one quarter.
cases.metricLabel: human-plus-model labelling, five years before the hype

cases.title: Customer-experience SaaS, built and billed
cases.summary: The full commercial surface of a CX product: journey-mapping module, tiered pricing, Stripe and PayPal checkout, blog engine and a programmatic SEO service generating landing pages from a template. Front end, payments and content infrastructure delivered by one team.

cases.title: Edunomics Scholar: a two-sided scholarship marketplace
cases.summary: Donors publish scholarships, invite and review applicants and award grants; applicants build profiles, apply and track status, with a super-admin console over both. 33 API endpoints, token auth with password reset, document upload, transactional email and status workflows. Three years of continuous development.
cases.metricLabel: API endpoints · donor, applicant and admin consoles

cases.title: Financial data pipelines
cases.summary: ETL scripts pulling, normalising and reconciling financial records into a single feed, the unglamorous plumbing that decides whether every dashboard above it is trustworthy.

cases.title: More are being written up in the same format
cases.summary: 34 products across 9 sectors and 374 repositories since 2018. We are writing them up in the same before-and-after format, and naming clients only where they have cleared it.
